title: PH60115: Solid State Ionics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Credits Introduction, solid state ionics vis-Ã -vis solid state electronics,
Principles of ionic conduction in ordered and disordered solids. Theories and
models of ionic conduction-phenomenological models, free volume theory,
configurational entropy model, jump relaxation and ion hopping model, bond
percolation model and effective medium theory. Superionic materials
classification-Crystalline anionic and cationic conductors, mixed ionic and
electronic conductors, structural factors responsible for high ionic
conductivity. Ion transport in homogeneous and heterogeneous medium-Ion
conducting glasses, ceramics, polymers and composites. Concepts and feasibility
of ion conducting polymer nanocomposites and nanocrystalline ceramics. Material
problems and processing terchniques. Physical techniques for analysis of ion
conducting solids. Transport properties and Ion dynamics. Application potential
of ion conducting solids in devices, Design, Fabrication and evaluation of
solid state lithium batteries, supercapacitors (EDLC and redox), PEM Fuel cell,
SOFC, Gas sensors and display devices. Thermodynamics and mass transport in
solid sate batteries. Battery performance and electrode kinetics. Double layer
and other polarization effects at solid /solid interface.
